### ⚡ Quick Upgrade / איך מתחילים ומשדרגים?

#### macOS / Linux:
```bash
cd RightSub && git pull && ./install.sh
# Or clean install:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omerninyo/RightSub/main/install.sh | bash
```

#### Windows (CMD / PowerShell):
```cmd
cd RightSub && git pull && install.bat
```
